translations.answer: This incident requires explicit definition of the world frame/robot frame orientation semantics, and speed, workspace, and human-robot distance constraints should be enforced before large leg movements; absolute and incremental mapping should be designed separately. The post does not provide a retest, and the delay is only an estimate, so it can only be considered as an unresolved safety case.
